uxui-blockchain.industry: A software company applying blockchain technology to security and information safety solutions.
uxui-blockchain.project_scope: Information architecture, UI design, interaction, design system, prototyping.
uxui-blockchain.title: SiNet app campaign
uxui-blockchain.desc:
SiNet is an internal social network and secure communication platform for enterprises, built on a private blockchain. It combines encrypted chat, task management, a personal work calendar, and an internal social feed in one mobile app. 
 My role was to redesign the the layout of existing screens, turning a mismatched interface into one consistent, trustworthy experience.
